item.title: VTTI and Höegh Evi take next step in permitting process for Zeeland Energy Terminal
item.description: VTTI and Höegh Evi has reached an important milestone with the permitting process for Zeeland Energy Terminal.

item.title: Endress+Hauser wins German Sustainability Award
item.description: Endress+Hauser has won the German Sustainability Award in the measurement and control technology sector.

item.title: MISTRAS awarded contract by Bechtel for Louisiana LNG project
item.description: MISTRAS Group, Inc. has been by Bechtel to deliver non-destructive testing services for the Woodside Louisiana LNG terminal.

item.title: PNG LNG project finance facility repaid in full
item.description: Santos has announced that the PNG LNG joint venture has accelerated the final repayment under the PNG LNG project finance facility, bringing the facility to a close.

item.title: Energy Department grants Woodside Louisiana LNG project additional time to commence exports
item.description: The U.S. Department of Energy has signed an amendment order granting an additional 44 months for Woodside Energy to commence LNG exports to non-FTA countries from the Woodside Louisiana LNG project.

item.title: MidOcean Energy completes acquisition of PETRONAS’ interest in LNG Canada project
item.description: MidOcean Energy has announced the completion of its acquisition of a 20% interest in PETRONAS’ key entities in LNG Canada.

item.title: ST LNG seeks LNG export permit
item.description: The Office of Fossil Energy and Carbon Management has received an application by ST LNG, LLC to export domestically produced LNG to free trade agreement and non-free trade agreement countries.

item.title: JERA signs LNG supply agreement with Hokkaido Gas
item.description: JERA Co., Inc. has signed an LNG sale and purchase agreement with Hokkaido Gas Co., Ltd.

item.title: Ukraine-ordered natural gas cargo arrives at Klaipeda LNG terminal
item.description: An LNG cargo from the US ordered by D.TRADING International SA has reached the Klaipeda LNG terminal, operated by KN Energies.

item.title: Stabilis Solutions announces marine bunkering agreement with Carnival Corp.
item.description: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. has entered into a definitive, 10-year offtake agreement with Carnival Corp. & plc to supply LNG in support of Carnival's cruise operations at the Port of Galveston.
